packages.role: Private compatibility library for SONAME libjpeg.so.62. Ubuntu 26 (resolute) official ARM64 provides no adequate provider: libjpeg-turbo8 ships SONAME libjpeg.so.8, and libjpeg62 (universe) is ancient jpeg6b version 1:6b2-4build1 which fails the Debian floor >= 1:1.5.0. Debian libjpeg62-turbo (1:2.1.5-4) provides the matching SONAME libjpeg.so.62 on arm64 and is staged only under the private engine path; no Ubuntu libc/libstdc++/system library is replaced.

Private compatibility library for SONAME libFLAC.so.14. This is a NEW SONAME, not an alias for the Noble libflac12t64 provider (libFLAC.so.12), which is absent from the authenticated Noble index. The exact Debian trixie libflac14 1.5.0+ds-2 arm64 build is staged only under the private engine path; the real library file is located at stage time by its ELF SONAME (no invented filename).
